summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 23, 2026. The filing discloses the election of 11 directors, re-appointment of the auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation, all with overwhelming shareholder support. No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring—is described. This is a routine current report of an annual meeting outcome, not a special-situation event.
